package_info.why_malicious: The provided report is a high-level industry analysis and does not describe any specific malicious package, code, or technical indicators. detection_knowledge.how_to_detect: This report does not provide technical details or code-level indicators for malware detection. It recommends general best practices such as integrating software composition analysis (SCA), adopting software bills of materials (SBOMs), and automating vulnerability management to improve supply chain security.
